stem: Voltmarkt cut a laptop's price by 10% in the week of Black Friday, compared with the week before, and its units tripled. An analyst reports the resulting arc elasticity as the laptop's price sensitivity. What is the main problem?

options.text: Black Friday lifted demand at the same time, so the cut gets the season's credit
Arc elasticity works only for price rises, so a price cut needs a different formula
A 10% change is too small a price move for the arc formula to be reliable
Elasticity should be measured on revenue, since units ignore the lower price
